hero.title: Gradisen SMART
hero.descriptor: Systematic Maintenance Assignment & Resource Tracking System
hero.subline: One system for maintenance requests, work orders and material stock across the office and the site. Site teams report defects, engineers carry out the work, and managers approve completion.

outcomes.title: What changes
outcomes.text: Requests are logged, workload is visible, and stock records match physical stock.

requests.title: Every request becomes a work order
requests.desc: Site staff record the location, priority and a photo at the point of request. The engineer receives a work order with the details attached.

visibility.title: Managers see the full workload
visibility.desc: Work orders are grouped by status, engineer and property. Approvals, due dates and the day's schedule are visible without follow-up calls.

stock.title: Materials are committed to the work order
stock.desc: Parts are reserved when the work order is raised, deducted on completion and released if the work is cancelled. Physical stock and system records stay aligned.

parts.title: Built for the site and the office
parts.subtitle: The mobile app supports field work; the web console covers administration and oversight. Both operate on the same records.

mobile.title: Mobile app
mobile.lead: For site staff and engineers working across corridors, plant rooms and basements, away from a desk.

points.raise: Raise a work order at the point of work, with location, priority and photos captured on site.
points.work: Accept, schedule, start and complete work orders, with actual times recorded automatically.
points.parts: Reserve materials against the work order and confirm available quantity before collection.
points.offline: Continue working in basements and plant rooms; work orders raised offline are submitted when connectivity returns.

web.title: Web management console
web.lead: For property managers and administrators who need a complete view of the property.

points.see: View all work orders by status, engineer and property, including the day's schedule and due dates.
points.approve: Review photos and recorded times, then approve completed work or return it to the engineer.
points.stock: Manage receipts, adjustments, stocktakes and low-stock alerts from one console.
points.reports: Export work order, stock movement, material usage and low-stock reports as PDF.

record.title: The office and the site share one record
record.text: A work order raised on a phone appears in the office immediately. Materials reserved on site are held against the same stock the office sees. When the work order is closed, the recorded times, photos, notes and materials remain attached to it.

job.title: One history per work order
job.desc: Status, photos, start and finish times, notes and materials remain with the work order, so the next assignee can continue without further enquiry.

stock.title: A stock ledger for every change
stock.desc: Every receipt, issue, adjustment and stocktake is recorded with its reason and the user responsible. Historical entries remain in the ledger.

access.title: Role-based access
access.desc: Site staff, engineers and managers have access to the functions their role requires. Account administration remains with administrators.

record.server: GDSmart is deployed on your own server and stores account names and maintenance records. It does not store resident or visitor profiles, identifiable photographs, identity numbers, licence plate numbers or biometric data.

cta.title: See it applied to your workflow
cta.text: We will walk through a repair and a material issue using your current process, and show what the office and the site would see.

story.title: What we do
story.p1: Gradisen builds robotics and software for warehouses and buildings. GDSense monitors the warehouse floor for safety hazards, cargo damage and misplaced stock. GDSmart manages maintenance requests, planned works and materials.
story.p2: Most sites cannot suspend operations to install a new system, so both products work with the racking, WMS and processes already in place.

deploy.title: Live within 24 hours
deploy.desc: GDSense moves from installation to live operation within 24 hours.

fit.title: No infrastructure rebuild
fit.desc: We leave the racking and WMS in place, and the office requires no additional hardware.

data.title: Data stays on site
data.desc: GDSense processes camera footage on the local edge server, so it does not leave the building.
